values.preview: Your workspace is ready. Here are three things worth doing in your first ten minutes.
values.headline: Your workspace is ready
values.intro: You can invite your team, connect a data source and build your first board today. Here is where to start.

steps.title: Connect a source
steps.body: Point it at your event stream or a CSV. The first chart shows up in under a minute.

steps.title: Invite one teammate
steps.body: Boards are better argued over. Share one with a colleague and leave a note on it.

steps.title: Set one alert
steps.body: Pick the number you check every morning and let it tell you when it moves.

values.signoff: Mara, who answers every reply to this email
